title: Fennel, bean and walnut patties with tomato salad

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every item is a plain staple: tinned beans, walnuts, breadcrumbs, cheese, egg, yoghurt and fresh produce.

supermarket.reason: Fennel, cannellini beans, walnuts, vegetarian hard cheese and cherry tomatoes are all everyday Tesco lines.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a grater, a masher and a frying pan, and shaping and shallow-frying patties is within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: Two tins of beans with one fennel bulb, crumbs, cheese and an egg make a sensible bound mix for 12 patties, three each, and 4 minutes a side cooks them through.

honest_times.reason: Grating, mashing, chopping and shaping fit roughly in 20 minutes, and two batches of 8 minutes come close to the 15 minutes of cooking printed.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including dill and lemon, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Fennel, dill and cherry tomatoes suit a mild late-September evening, and the fennel leads the patties.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no restaurant jargon or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Beans, walnuts, egg and cheese make a filling protein-rich patty, served with a fresh tomato salad and yoghurt.
